verdicts.title: Dash recharge shows 5 right after a dash (false positive)
verdicts.observed: After dash-down, dashCooldown=5 and HUD shows 'Dash 5'. The check expected 6 on the same tick.
verdicts.expected: Section 3: a dash sets the recharge to 6, which then counts down at the end of the same running tick, so the HUD shows 'Dash 5' right after a dash. The build matches this. The check misreads the design.

verdicts.title: Paused-frozen check misfires on Restart (symptom is the restart bug in candidate 2)
verdicts.observed: During the paused state, the timer goes from 299 to 300 on the click to btn-restart. That change is the restart reset, not a leak from pausing. The state stays paused after the restart, which is the real defect covered by candidate 2.
verdicts.expected: While paused, nothing moves and the timer is frozen. A restart resets the timer to 300, which is an intended reset and not a frozen-state violation. The check should exempt restart events.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
verdicts.observed: From the pause menu, click btn-restart resets the state (score 0, lives 3, time 300) but mode stays 'paused' with the pause menu still open and event 'restart'. Ticks then do nothing (time stays 300) through tick 31 and beyond.
verdicts.expected: Section 7: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', no dialog).

verdicts.title: Spikes at score 0 give score 65036 instead of 0 (unsigned wrap)
verdicts.observed: Score is 0 before the spike hit. After right+dash-down (spikes, respawn) the score is 65036, which is 0 - 500 wrapped modulo 65536. Lives drop 3 to 2 as expected.
verdicts.expected: Section 5: spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0 (never negative), so the score should stay 0 after the hit.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-400) after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After the spike hit the score is 65036 (the wrapped value of -500). Collecting a coin then shows score -400 (signed 16-bit wrap of 65136 style arithmetic on -500 + 100), with HUD Score -400.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative. The spike penalty should floor it at 0, and a coin should give +100 from there (score 100).

verdicts.title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: The state shows coins=1 after the dash picks up a coin, but the HUD text still reads 'Coins 0/5' on the same tick.
verdicts.expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows current values, so after one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Player moves on the tick that pauses the game
verdicts.observed: Replay esc+right: the game pauses (mode paused, event pause) but the player also moves from (1,1) to (2,1) in that same tick.
verdicts.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens. The player should stay at (1,1).

verdicts.title: HUD Time lags one tick behind the timer
verdicts.observed: After click:btn-resume the state has timeLeft 299 but the HUD still displays Time 300.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current timer value, so it should display Time 299 to match timeLeft.

verdicts.title: Toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
verdicts.observed: While paused with the 'Key collected' toast visible, btn-resume is reported top=false, so a click at its centre hits the toast instead of the button.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover Resume or Restart level while the pause menu is open.

verdicts.title: Spikes wrap score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0
verdicts.observed: Score was 100 and spikes hit (cost 500). Score became 65136 (an unsigned wrap of -400) instead of 0. Lives dropped correctly to 2.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0, so the score should be 0 after the hit.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative and wraps after spike hit
verdicts.observed: Spike hit at 0 score gave 65036 (wrapped), then a coin pushed it to -400 displayed in the HUD.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and spikes floor it at 0; after the spike the score should be 0, then 100 after the coin.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-down+dash-right collects a coin, state shows coins=1 but the HUD displays Coins 0/5.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read Coins 1/5.

verdicts.title: HUD Time lags one tick behind the timer after resuming via Resume button
verdicts.observed: At tick 20 (click:btn-resume), the running tick drops timeLeft to 282 (dash recharge also drops 2 to 1), but HUD Time still shows 283. The HUD stays one tick stale (283 vs 281, then 283 vs 280) for the rest of the run.
verdicts.expected: HUD Time always shows the current timer value (ticks left), matching timeLeft after every tick, including the tick that resumes from pause.

verdicts.title: Spikes at score 100 wrap score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0
verdicts.observed: At tick 14 the player hits spikes with score 100; score becomes 65136 (100 - 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit). Similar wraps occur elsewhere (300 -> 65336). Later runs show negative scores (-300) as well.
verdicts.expected: Spikes subtract 500 points with the score floored at 0: score should be 0 after hitting spikes at score 100.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-700) after collecting a coin following spike damage
verdicts.observed: Score is 64736 before tick 97, then 65136-style wrap/underflow produces score -700 at tick 97 after a coin pickup; score shown as -600 in HUD thereafter.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and is floored at 0 when spikes are hit; it must stay within 0..999,999.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins counter lags one coin behind the actual coin count
verdicts.observed: After the dash-down collects a coin at tick 2, state coins=1 but HUD shows Coins 0/5; the HUD stays one behind (coins=3 shows 1/5) for the rest of the run, while Score is updated correctly.
verdicts.expected: HUD Coins n/5 always shows the current coin count, equal to state coins.

verdicts.title: HUD Time stays at 300 for one tick after Resume click while timer advanced to 299
verdicts.observed: At tick 1 (click:btn-resume), the running tick drops timeLeft to 299 but HUD Time still shows 300.
verdicts.expected: HUD Time shows the current timer value (299) after the resume tick runs.
